antiDefaults: Default: dark terminal-console theme across the whole surface. Why likely: tool vocabulary (Bash, Read, Write) and phosphor heritage make dark feel capable. Remains right when: the product is positioned as an operator console used in dim rooms for long monitoring. Alternative here: warm paper reading ground with a restrained status-pip plus label system that works in light and survives grayscale, reserving dark to code/detail wells only.

Default: card piles for turns, tools, and sidebars. Why likely: cards are the fastest way to group heterogeneous stub content. Remains right when: turns are heterogeneous attachments with no shared reading order. Alternative here: one continuous ruled page where turns are chapters separated by hairline rules and numerals, and only the summoned verification sheet earns elevation on a scrim.

Default: follow-ups as a chip cloud plus badge-heavy status pills. Why likely: chips signal cheap steering and pills signal liveness at a glance. Remains right when: steering is the primary content rather than reading. Alternative here: follow-ups set as a calm numbered list under the latest answer with generous leading, and status carried by small numerals plus text labels so hierarchy comes from rhythm not badges.

Default: streaming shimmer, pulsing running rows, and toast errors. Why likely: motion proves the agent is working and toasts avoid layout shift. Remains right when: the loop is monitored continuously like a dashboard. Alternative here: breath motion — quiet caret for streaming, single height ease for disclosure, in-place failure rows with retry that never auto-dismiss, every change legible statically under reduced motion.

Default: persistent docked three-pane dashboard plus ambient AI gradient as identity. Why likely: it proves both sidebars exist at every width and gradients signal modern AI. Remains right when: density itself is the capability story. Alternative here: withdrawn slim rails that open on demand and full-bleed reading sheets only when summoned, with identity carried by the marginal-numeral citation system instead of ambient glow.
color: Quiet grounds carry reading; saturated color is rationed to meaning and always redundant with label plus shape. Warm paper ground (warm off-white) is the only continuous field; ink carries body text at AA 4.5:1. Chrome (rail labels, rules, sidenote metadata) is desaturated warm gray at 3:1 minimum for non-text structure with text labels meeting body contrast. Signal color has exactly three jobs: status triad (success green, running amber, failed red) always paired with a text label and a pip icon; diff semantics (added green, removed red) always paired with +/- and mono context; reference blue reserved for links, URLs, and the browser sheet. No ambient AI gradient, no decorative glow, no status-by-color-alone. Grayscale test must preserve every distinction through numerals, labels, and rules. The thesis decides this: color never raises its voice above the essay; it only certifies and cites.
composition: Editorial page with marginalia. The center is a measure-constrained article column (60-72ch, true text size, generous leading) holding one idea per viewport: user turn as a short rubric, assistant answer as essay, tool activity as numbered marginal notes in the gutter keyed to superscript numerals inside the prose. Tool notes render as ruled sidenotes at wide widths and as footnote-style rows expanding in place at narrow widths — never as cards, never as a separate timeline. Both sidebars withdraw to slim rails (session rail left, evidence rail right, hairline column rules) that open on demand via click, tap, or keyboard; the page never squeezes the measure below legibility. Verification views (browser excerpt, file tree plus diff, GitHub summary) are full-bleed reading sheets summoned onto a quiet scrim, each carrying the numeral range that summoned it, dismissed back to the margin. Follow-ups are a calm ordered list under the latest answer, not a chip cloud. Density is the lowest of the slate by design: all density is spent inside an expanded note and inside a summoned sheet, so the default viewport stays a reading room with the workbench visible behind glass. The calm-reading vs capability tension is resolved structurally: capability is withdrawn, not removed — one gesture away, cited inline, never competing with the sentence being read.
divergenceAxes: Compositional model: editorial page plus marginalia with withdrawable rails and summoned sheets, vs the category default of a chatbot column with bolted-on panels, vs dossier audit rails, ops-board grids, and spine-plus-tickets.
Information density: lowest default density with one idea per viewport and density-on-demand inside notes and sheets, vs high-everywhere control-room density and vs medium rhythmic ticket density.
Motion role: breath — fades, one height ease, quiet caret, reduced-motion instant — vs attestation flips, signal pulses and cuts, and progress-along-the-rail narration.

Surface logic: continuous warm paper ruled by hairlines with glass sheets only when called, vs paper ledger annexes, dark instrument wells with raised action caps, and ticket-stack cards with active-only elevation.

Typographic voice: editorial serif reading face at true text size with structured sans chrome and mono quarantined to code and detail, vs affidavit rail caps, console-tabular mono-forward, and workmanlike grotesk with turn numerals.
domainWorld: The library behind glass: practitioners sit over the agent's shoulder between bench (editor plus terminal), library (files, history, GitHub, docs), and mission wall (browser, previews). Crossing: the center is a reading desk and the wings are a quiet library withdrawn to slim rails; evidence is summoned as a reading sheet, not parked as a wall of panels.

Paper printouts of diffs marked up by hand and the marginalia tradition: the field already reads long outputs on paper and annotates the margin. Crossing: tool claims carry superscript numerals matched to ruled marginal notes, translated one level from literal paper texture into a citation layout that binds prose, note, and verification view.

Burst-pause-verify rhythm: slow deliberate typing, fast bursts of mixed-duration tool calls (millisecond Read, seconds-long Bash and tests), prose streaming, then verification, steering, or interruption. Crossing: motion as breath — a quiet caret for streaming, staged note reveals for longer runs, disclosure with a single ease — so rhythm is felt as continuity, never as theater.

Trust-but-verify anxiety plus vigilance fatigue: delegating consequential work to a fast non-deterministic junior while remaining accountable, exhausted by watching every call yet afraid to look away. Crossing: every turn that claims work carries its numerals or an explicit empty-trace line, failures render in place with retry, and calm is load-bearing so sustained attention costs less.

Materials and light of the bench: screen glow in a dim room, syntax highlights as small stained glass, status lamps (green nominal, amber working, red failed), separation by rules and inset wells rather than elevation. Crossing: warm paper ground with hairline rules, code and detail quarantined to quiet wells, light meaning status only — pip plus label, never ambient glow.
evidencePlan: Specimen 1 — First view at 1440px: populated session with article column, numbered tool claims, gutter marginal notes, slim rails, composer with follow-up list; proves hierarchy and lowest density.
Specimen 2 — Signature in place: assistant turn with numerals 1-4 keyed to marginal notes and the summoned file-diff sheet header citing the same range; proves citation-as-layout.

Specimen 3 — Central component: marginal note expansion in place (summary to detail with paths, command, duration, status label) plus slim-rail opening interaction; proves progressive disclosure without cards.
Specimen 4 — Non-happy states: tool failure row rendered in place with retry at full calm (no toast), plus empty session and streaming caret states; proves failures stay urgent on a quiet ground.
Specimen 5 — Typography and surface at working density: long assistant answer with code well, sidenote metadata, hairline rules, warm ground; proves serif/sans/mono discipline.
Specimen 6 — Responsive behavior at 375px: single column with rails as drawers/tabs, marginalia as footnote rows expanding in place, composer persistently reachable, no horizontal scroll.
motion: Motion is breath: it keeps continuity, never demands attention. Page and sheet transitions fade over a short ease; disclosure opens with a single height ease and closes symmetrically; streaming is a quiet caret with no shimmer and no skeleton theater beyond a calm placeholder line; rails slide or fade as one movement, never staggered. Running tools do not pulse; the note's status label advances from running to succeeded or failed with a text change plus pip, persistent after settling. Interrupt and retry acknowledge within one frame change but without flash. Every animated change has a reduced-motion fallback that resolves instantly to the final state with the status label intact, and every state is legible as a static frame. The thesis decides this: the room never startles the reader, so motion narrates only what changed and where the citation now points.
productInterpretation: This product is a long editorial document that happens to execute commands: a builder reads an argument in the center and checks its citations without leaving the page. The agentic chat surface is therefore a reading room with a workbench behind a glass wall — the essay on the desk, the machinery visible but silent until cited. Calm-reading vs capability tension is explicit and structural: calm wins the default viewport because sustained verification is the real task, and capability wins the first gesture because every claim is numbered, every number opens its note, and every note summons its sheet. Restraint here is not minimalism; it is accountability made legible — one idea per viewport so that trust can keep up with speed.
risks: Underplays capability: at 1440px the withdrawn rails can read as an article page rather than a session-scoped workbench unless rail affordances and numeral density signal live machinery.
Failures too quiet: breath motion and warm grounds can soften urgency; the in-place failure row with persistent label plus retry must carry the weight that pulse and toast normally carry.
Wide-viewport emptiness: one idea per viewport risks a sparse canvas on large screens; the gutter, rails, and measure must compose as intentional margins, not leftover space.
Numeral fatigue in heavy turns: turns with many tool calls strain superscript sequences; capping inline numerals and collapsing notes to ranges must hold or the margin becomes a second document.
Gutter collapse complexity: translating sidenotes to footnote rows at narrow widths doubles the disclosure pattern and must stay keyboard-clean with visible focus and live-region announcements.
signature: Marginal evidence numerals: every consequential tool claim inside assistant prose carries a small superscript numeral that matches a ruled marginal note in the gutter (or footnote row at narrow widths) and, when summoned, the header of the corresponding verification sheet. Recurrence: the numeral appears in all three places — inline claim, margin note, sheet header — on every assistant turn that claims work, in every session, across all three verification views (browser, files, GitHub). Regulation: numerals are rationed so recurrence reads as system, not tic — only consequential tool calls earn numerals (routine reads may group under one note); at most a small capped run of inline numerals per turn before notes collapse to a labeled range (for example notes 3-7); user prose, follow-ups, and mode labels never carry numerals; empty-trace turns show an explicit unnumbered empty-trace line instead; the sheet header always cites the exact numeral range that summoned it so evidence never detaches from its claim.
surfaces: Warm paper plus glass. One continuous warm matte ground carries everything ambient: the article column, the gutters, the slim rails separated by hairline column rules, not by shadows or cards. Marginal notes are ruled sidenotes — same ground, a rule above, small metadata line — deepening to a quiet inset well only for code, commands, and diffs. Depth exists in exactly two levels: the ambient page (everything default) and the summoned sheet. Sheets (browser excerpt, file tree plus diff, GitHub summary) float above on a dimming scrim only when called from a numeral, with their own reading header citing the numeral range; dismissing returns to the unbroken page. No card piles, no raised chrome except the composer's send and the failure retry, which earn the only decisive elevation as world-changing controls. The thesis decides this: the ground never breaks, so breaking it — a sheet on scrim — always means evidence has been summoned.
systemPotential: The page-plus-margin grammar scales because it is a rule system, not a layout. Longer content: 50-plus-turn sessions paginate as chapters with a quiet marginal index (turn numerals plus failure marks) that jumps without becoming a timeline spine; long answers keep one idea per viewport with numerals preventing context loss. Shorter content: a one-line answer with one note still composes — measure, rule, and rail spacing are fixed, so brevity reads intentional. All states: streaming shows the caret plus a calm placeholder line; running notes show labeled stubs; failures render as in-place ruled rows with retry (never toasts); empty session, empty message list, and empty sidebar views are set as editorial colophons with one clear next action; overflow wraps within the measure and sheets scroll internally, never pushing the page sideways. All viewports: 1440px shows column plus both gutters and slim rails; mid widths dock one rail and overlay the other; 375px collapses to a single column with rails as drawers or tabs and marginalia as footnote rows expanding in place, the composer persistently reachable, no horizontal scroll. All three verification views reuse the same sheet template with numeral-range headers. Further surfaces (for example a session history or review surface) inherit the same grammar: essay center, cited margin, summoned sheets.
thesis: The agentic session is an essay argued in the center and proven in the margin: one calm idea per viewport, with every tool claim numbered where it is made and verifiable where it is checked.
typography: Editorial: the reading face carries the voice and chrome stays quiet. Assistant prose and user rubrics are set in a serif or serif-adjacent reading face at a true text size with generous leading; hierarchy comes from size and rhythm (title, lede, body, sidenote) rather than badges or pills. Chrome — rail labels, surnames of sessions, view tabs, follow-up list items — is a small structured sans, uppercase or small-size with wide tracking for role labels (YOU, AGENT, NOTE). Monospace is quarantined strictly to code and evidence detail: paths, commands, diffs, durations, refs. Scale logic is musical: body sets the measure, sidenotes step down one grade, sheet headers step up one grade, numerals are superscript at sidenote grade so the citation thread is visible without interrupting the sentence. The thesis decides this: type proves the essay comes first and the machinery cites, never shouts.
